arguments.question: Analyze ANET’s operating outlook and valuation for the 5/21/63-session mandate. Use the latest SEC/company materials to bridge AI networking demand, enterprise/campus growth, customer concentration, competition, supply commitments, margins, cash flow and share count into earnings and cash-flow assumptions. Separate dated Q3 2026 company guidance from timestamped third-party analyst consensus; report consensus unavailable if the source lacks a timestamp. Compute and interpret one bear/base/bull annual EPS×P/E grid and, for this single-company mandate, calculate forward P/E, EV/revenue and five-year DCF per-share values in one three-method analysis, including assumptions, reverse expectations/break-even inputs, method divergence, joint earnings/multiple risk and comparison with the 2026-09-22 split-adjusted close. Stop when primary filings/results plus one dated consensus source are sufficient, or state the exact unavailable input rather than continuing discovery.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether operating quality and three valuation methods support conditional upside, downside or only decision boundaries at the observed price.
